patches_modified.name: Add 'Give Kudos' button to 'Group Activity'
patches_modified.description: Adds a button that triggers the same action as shaking your phone would.

patches_modified.name: Add media download
patches_modified.description: Extends the full-screen media viewer menu with items to copy or open their URLs or download them directly.

patches_modified.name: Block Snowplow tracking
patches_modified.description: Blocks Snowplow analytics. See https://snowplow.io for more information.

patches_modified.name: Disable Quick Edit
patches_modified.description: Prevents the Quick Edit prompt from popping up.

patches_modified.name: Enable password login
patches_modified.description: Re-enables password login after having used an OTP code.

patches_modified.name: Hide distractions
patches_modified.description: Hides elements that are not essential.

patches_modified.name: Overwrite media upload parameters
patches_modified.description: Overwrites the compression, resize and trim media (images and videos) parameters returned by Strava's server before upload.

patches_added.name: Clean up main UI
patches_added.description: Hides the nav drawer's Guide/Rate/Help/About items and the bottom navigation view, and keeps the Connect/Create/Join buttons on top.

patches_added.name: Skip splash screen
patches_added.description: Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation entirely.

patches_added.name: GX icon pack
patches_added.description: Adds a separate native selector for all 56 Opera GX launcher icons. Open it from the GX Icon Pack long-press shortcut.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Makes dark-theme page, app navigation and system bars pure black (AMOLED) while keeping elevated cards, sheets and controls gray so their boundaries remain visible.

patches_modified.name: Block listings
patches_modified.description: Hides Avito offers from blacklisted adverts or sellers and adds a blacklist manager (import/export compatible with the Ave Blacklist extension).

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables Avito first-party clickstream analytics and Avito's direct Adjust telemetry wrapper.

patches_modified.name: Disable update prompts
patches_modified.description: Prevents Avito's force-update screen opener from launching update screens. Toggleable in Настройки Morphe.

patches_modified.name: Hide professional sellers
patches_modified.description: Adds a maximum seller review count to Avito search filters and hides or dims offers from sellers above that limit.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Настройки Morphe" entry to Avito's settings that hosts the configuration for the other Morphe patches.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Disables Avito ads by removing ad SDK entry points and short-circuiting commercial banner loading.

patches_modified.name: UI tweaks
patches_modified.description: Optional interface tweaks, each toggleable in Настройки Morphe: single-row home categories, hide the "Подписки" tab in Избранное, hide installments (Рассрочка) and the "Спросите у продавца" block on offers, expand descriptions by default (no "Читать далее"), hide reserved offers and offer recommendations, hide profile raffle, referral and Avito Pro promos, and hide the Avi assistant tab in the bottom navigation.
